transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, the commissioning is planned for Thursday, and I need to hear from environmental health and safety, controls engineering, and production supervision on your constraints and commitments for pre-Thursday deliverables. Once each function has stated their constraints and committed to the deliverables, I can authorize the work. Can we start with EHS -- what constraints do you have, and what can you commit to delivering before Thursday?
